name: dizzyjaguar
description: Claude Code skills by Eli Zevin. Each skill is its own plugin, so you install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: learn-by-doing
plugins.description: Turn a topic you want to learn into a project you build by hand. Claude scaffolds the inert setup and writes a phased build guide containing no code, then reviews your work phase by phase.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Run one Linear ticket, or the next ready ticket under a parent, through a fresh agent per ticket. The agent leaves changes in the working tree and reports files changed, tests run and one commit line per repo; you commit.
